targets.query: from(bucket: "bucketakke") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => (r.host =~ /$host/ or "$host" == ".*") ) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "host.cpu.usage") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 1000000.0 }))

from(bucket: "bucketakke") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => (r.host =~ /$host/ or "$host" == ".*")) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "host.storage.mount.space.free") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }) ) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0 }))
